sources.title: SQLite Write-Ahead Logging
sources.locator: Overview, concurrency, checkpoints, synchronous durability, WAL sidecar and compatibility
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: WAL is optional; all processes using it must be on one host; one writer; default auto-checkpoint at 1000 pages; database and WAL are joint persistent state; NORMAL can lose recent commits on power loss.
sources.applicability: Local durability candidate and safe transfer boundary.
sources.limits: Does not specify this app's distributed merge rules or validate its filesystem/VFS.

sources.title: SQLite synchronous PRAGMA
sources.locator: synchronous setting and rollback/WAL matrix
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: FULL in WAL is ACID; NORMAL preserves consistency but can roll back latest transaction after power loss; actual default depends on journal mode.
sources.applicability: Define when local save may be reported durable.
sources.limits: Hardware/filesystem behavior still needs qualification.

sources.title: SQLite Session Module API
sources.locator: Primary key capture; changeset_apply conflict types and OMIT/REPLACE/ABORT

sources.title: SQLite Online Backup API
sources.locator: Online Backup snapshot and other backup techniques
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Online Backup creates a coherent snapshot while users continue; external raw copy during OS/power failure can be corrupt.
sources.applicability: Safe basis for manual snapshot/export.
sources.limits: A snapshot is not a merge protocol.

sources.title: SQLite corruption cautions
sources.locator: Crash recovery; journal/WAL pairing
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Journal files are needed after interrupted writes; moving/removing sidecar files can defeat recovery.
sources.applicability: Do not sync a live database as independent files.
sources.limits: Does not solve DB plus photo filesystem transactions.

sources.title: CouchDB conflict/revision model
sources.released_version_or_commit: CouchDB 3.5 stable docs; current stable release notes include 3.5.3; page itself is not version-pinned.
sources.locator: Conflict leaves, deterministic winner, 409 on local stale revision, resolution
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Replicated leaves survive; ordinary reads select one deterministic winner; local stale _rev writes are rejected and retried by caller.
sources.applicability: Sync alternative and evidence that data preservation still needs an operator review surface.
sources.limits: Winner selection is not scientific review; document granularity may be coarse.

sources.title: CouchDB replication protocol
sources.released_version_or_commit: CouchDB 3.5 stable docs; current stable release notes include 3.5.3; page itself is not version-pinned.
sources.locator: Push/pull, checkpoints, retry behavior and large-attachment streaming
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: HTTP replication is unidirectional per run; push then pull exchanges both ways; large attachments may use multipart streaming; some errors are not retried.
sources.applicability: Mature sync alternative and attachment cost control.
sources.limits: Still requires reachable peers; manual removable media is not supplied by HTTP sync.

sources.applicability: Relevant delete/photo edge case.
sources.limits: Version-specific fix, not evidence all CouchDB attachment replication fails.
